messages.content: Build a chess engine in 4 KB Python for the make.fun tiny-chess-01 bounty.
Shrink to under 4096 bytes after compression.

Minified heavily. Replaced multi-line PST arrays with single compact lists. Inlined many helpers. Final engine.py is 3515 bytes after makefun compress.

Added TT={} and Killer heuristic:
TT={}

def negamax(bd,a,b,d,white):
    h=tuple(bd)
    if h in TT and TT[h][0]>=d: return TT[h][1]
    ...
